bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: An Academic Writing Task 1 shows a line graph with several lines over 20 years. What should the response focus on?

options.text: The main trends and notable comparisons between the lines
options.rationale: Correct: Task 1 rewards selecting and grouping key features and comparisons.

options.text: Every individual data point for each line
options.rationale: Listing every point lacks selection and overviews, lowering task achievement.

options.text: The candidate's opinion on the trends
options.rationale: Task 1 is a factual overview; opinion belongs in Task 2.

options.text: A single sentence summary with no detail
options.rationale: Too little detail fails the task requirements.

items.explanation: Task 1 requires an overview of key features with supporting comparisons, not every datum.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: A Task 2 prompt says 'To what extent do you agree or disagree?' What must the essay contain?

options.text: A clear, consistent position stated and developed throughout
options.rationale: Correct: the prompt requires a clear stance maintained across the essay.

options.text: A neutral summary with no stance
options.rationale: Not taking a position fails task response for this prompt type.

options.text: Two unrelated opinions switched between paragraphs
options.rationale: An inconsistent position lowers coherence and task response.

options.text: Only a list of facts with no argument
options.rationale: A fact list without a position does not answer an agree/disagree prompt.

items.explanation: Agree/disagree prompts require a clear, consistent and developed position.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: Which TWO improvements raise 'Grammatical Range and Accuracy'?

options.text: Using a mix of simple and complex sentences accurately
options.rationale: Correct: range plus accuracy is exactly what this criterion rewards.

options.text: Reducing frequent errors that obscure meaning
options.rationale: Correct: fewer meaning-blocking errors directly raises accuracy.

options.text: Using only very short simple sentences throughout
options.rationale: Limited range caps the band even if accurate.

options.text: Adding rare idioms regardless of correctness
options.rationale: Misused idioms harm accuracy and belong to lexis, not grammar.

options.text: Removing all punctuation to look advanced
options.rationale: Poor punctuation reduces accuracy and clarity.

items.explanation: This criterion rewards accurate use of a range of structures, not length or idioms.
